patch_list: Prevents the rotating ad banner from appearing at the bottom of the Devices screen.
Prevents the AI-generated motivational modal from appearing after a blood pressure reading.
Hides the 'Buy more iHealth devices?' link at the bottom of the Devices screen.

Changes the package name to allow installation alongside the original app and renames the app to 'iHealth Morphe'. Disables Firebase initialization, which would otherwise crash on startup when the new package name is not registered.
